name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $104 after deal-hope fall; Hormuz still largely shut
state: Brent was near $103.9 early on 4 Nov, after falling 7.4% to $105 on 2 Nov on hopes of a US–Iran deal (CBS), and about 4% up on the month. Alert holds on the physical supply outage: Hormuz remains largely shut, and Iran said on 3–4 Nov it would reopen the strait only once its conditions are met (SBS).
for_you: Fuel and heating costs remain high and sensitive to Gulf headlines; transport and energy-intensive businesses are most exposed.
rubric_hit: Brent $103 has not yet cleared the $99 exit line, so Alert holds

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates
SBS News — Iran says 'long way to go' until end of war

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
